articles.summary: Octave Specialty Group, Inc. (“Octave”) (NYSE: OSG), a global specialty insurance firm, today announced that Philip Stefano has joined the company as Managing Director, Head of Investor Relations. Philip Stefano joins Octave Specialty Group as Head of Investor Relations Stefano joins from Essent Group, where he was Vice President of Investor Relations and Corporate Development for the last five years. Prior to that, he served as Director of Equity Research at Deutsche Bank, where he was a lead analyst covering the property and casualty insurance and insurance brokerage sectors. He brings more than 20 years of insurance and financial services experience, with a background spanning investor relations, equity research, financial analysis, and actuarial consulting, including roles at Citigroup, Aon, Ernst Young, and AIG. articles.summary: New monoline offering provides needed coverage for General Liability accounts Pivix Specialty Insurance Services Inc. (“Pivix”), an excess and surplus lines managing general agent majority owned by Octave Specialty Group, Inc. (NYSE: OSG), has launched a monoline assault and battery program designed to meet the insurance requirements of accounts needing this important coverage. The program is supported by an A+ AM Best rated insurer and available nationwide on an ES basis. Distributed exclusively through wholesale brokers, the new program targets apartment complexes, condominium associations, homeowner associations, lessor’s risk properties, hotels, restaurants and bars, and retail stores.
